products.description: Discover premium softness at an incredible price with Scott ComfortPlus toilet paper rolls. Offering everyday comfort plus reliable strength, this bath tissue is 3x thicker and 4x stronger than the leading value brand. Our toilet tissue combines just the right amount of softness and strength by featuring thick and plush sheets for a comforting clean. These toilet paper rolls are also trusted for flushability, as Scott ComfortPlus is septic-safe, sewer-safe, clog-free, and dissolves 10x faster*. With Scott ComfortPlus 1-ply toilet paper, you get 12 Triple Rolls of 231 sheets per roll. Get more with Scott and order Scott ComfortPlus in bulk online! (*vs national brand soft & strong)
